question: Who is eligible for the housing support programme?
context: Housing Support Programme — Eligibility. Applicants must be a current resident of the borough and have a household income below the published threshold. Applications from those with an active tenancy dispute are assessed by the casework team first. Support is not means of last resort: applicants may hold savings up to £16,000.
